Maya (Design): Quick question: what if the left rail groups are reduced to 3 and each item exposes a tiny link icon for sharing? Wanted to check keyboard/voiceover flows.
Ravi (Frontend): For keyboard, the icon must be focusable and visible on focus. We can show it with outline and aria-label.
Lina (PM): Product note: shared links need to be stable and land on the same tab. If someone arrives from monitoring, we can show "via Monitoring" as context but not change canonical path.
Omar (Eng): Routing idea: keep canonical at /resources/:id, use ?from=monitoring as optional context param. When copying link, strip ephemeral params.
Eli (A11y Bot): A11y check: make copy action reachable via keyboard menu (Enter or Space) and ensure announcement after copy: "Link copied to clipboard". Tooltip is not sufficient.
Maya (Design): Visuals: small 14px link glyph, appears on hover/focus. On mobile, expose copy in item overflow menu instead.
Ravi (Frontend): I'll prototype with existing popover, include focus trap and ARIA announcements.
Lina (PM): Rollout: internal 5% -> monitor support tickets referencing links. Also track copy CTA metric.
Omar (Eng): We'll maintain allowlist of params that survive copy. Anything else removed.
Maya (Design): Great. I'll update the sketch and add the aria-label samples. Thanks.
